info.title: Restb.ai Vision API
info.description: Restb.ai computer vision for real estate photos (room type, features, condition, compliance...). Reconstructed from the sample code of Restb.ai's own public SDK (https://github.com/restbai/sdk, Apache-2.0): the endpoints, the hosts and the parameters. Restb.ai keeps its API documentation (https://docs.restb.ai/) behind a client login, so the models and their answers are not described here.

get.summary: Run one model on an image (image by URL)

schema.description: Comma-separated list of models for multipredict (the public SDK samples use re_roomtype_global_v2, re_exterior_styles, re_features_v4, re_logo, re_compliance_v2, re_condition_r1r6_global)

200.description: The predictions of the models. Restb.ai documents the answer only to its customers: it is free-form JSON here.

post.summary: Run one model on an image (image as base64 in the body)

model_id.description: Comma-separated list of models for multipredict (the public SDK samples use re_roomtype_global_v2, re_exterior_styles, re_features_v4, re_logo, re_compliance_v2, re_condition_r1r6_global)

image_base64.description: URL-safe base64 of the image (the public samples mark this for development only)

200.description: The predictions of the models. Restb.ai documents the answer only to its customers: it is free-form JSON here.
